verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents percentage rollouts through a segment rule using the % Split condition, which takes a value between 1 and 100. It also documents gradually enabling a feature for a percentage of users and changing flags without deploying new code, so the 1%→100% ramp is covered. Nothing in the evidence describes how users are assigned to the percentage bucket, so consistent bucketing is unproven. missing for 10: documentation of consistent/sticky bucketing (e.g. deterministic hashing so users stay in the cohort as the percentage grows), independent or hands-on corroboration of percentage rollouts.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll a flag out progressively by percentage with consistent bucketing, ramping from 1% to 100% without redeploying

citations.quote: Add a rule defined with the % Split condition. Specify a value between 1 and 100 to define what percentage of your user base is included within this segment.
Rollouts by percentage (also known as staged feature rollouts) allow you to test a new feature with a small subset of your user base.
Gradually enable a feature for a percentage of users, either globally or within a segment.
Easily toggle individual features on and off, and make changes without deploying new code
